_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v543_dual_decoder_50k/plan/preregistration_signoff.json (plan §12 WP0 / ADR-0034 §6). Copy, fill *_sha256 fields at freeze time, keep thresholds_signed_frozen byte-identical to config/campaigns/pes2ts_v543_dual_decoder_50k.yaml thresholds block (all 19 signed keys of appendix B; not run-level values). D1–D8 were signed by the repository owner through the DSH orchestration session on 2026-11-02 together with three run authorizations (① governance go/no-go verified internally by the orchestrator, ② smoke-gated auto-launch of formal runs, ③ confirm sealed / new_QC_calls=0 / dev one-shot at T7 only). The reviewer (oracle_gate0_reviewer) is NEVER a signatory; statistics/evaluation signoff belongs to main_session_owner. This template is the TEMPLATE of the t1_start_requires record requirement preregistration_signoff_record — the INSTANCE at outputs/pesn/v543_dual_decoder_50k/plan/preregistration_signoff.json is machine-checked by scripts/agent_ops/v543_config_schema.py (prereg: t1_blocked reason; --formal: typed V543_RECORD_MISSING / V543_RECORD_MISMATCH). The validator requires the instance to mirror the frozen config — config_path equals config/campaigns/pes2ts_v543_dual_decoder_50k.yaml, campaign_id/gv_campaign_id/schema_id/schema equal PES2TS_V543_DUAL_DECODER_50K / V5.4.3 / pes2ts_v543_dual_decoder_campaign_v1 / pes2ts_v543_preregistration_signoff_v1, signed_by_roles is EXACTLY the frozen role-key set, the thresholds block is byte-equal to the config thresholds, and record_sha256 equals sha256(canonical_bytes(instance payload without record_sha256)) (compact sorted-key JSON, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false); a missing digest is V543_RECORD_MISSING, a wrong digest is V543_RECORD_MISMATCH. The sibling runplan_pin_record is verified by the WP5 runner at the runplan freeze, never by this WP0 validator.
record_sha256_note: fill at freeze time: sha256 of canonical_bytes(instance JSON payload with record_sha256 removed) — compact sorted-key JSON, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false; validator verifies at --formal

authorization.decision_scope: D1–D8 全部采用建议值（F1–F8 八处修正、新 fixed-coverage 定义、36K±5% 参数匹配、37,900 flat + 400 warmup、两 Track 独立损失、V543 M0/P0 重算基线、18-run 上限、q_corr 降级为诊断）

thresholds_signed_frozen.basis: 附录 B 预注册阈值表（签认版）; 签认后不得按 seed17/dev 结果修改, 改值须重走签认并同步 config/runplan/budget SHA

evaluation_statistics_contract.matched_seed_baseline: V543_M0_P0_recomputed (S0 在 V543 evaluator 下重算, SHA 冻结; 不用 V542 归档数字)
evaluation_statistics_contract.bootstrap: curve-level (reaction cluster) paired, 10,000 draws, percentile 95% CI, seed-averaged per draw before comparison
evaluation_statistics_contract.p_value: one-sided improvement paired cluster bootstrap: p = (1 + #{seed-averaged paired bootstrap improvement <= 0}) / 10001
evaluation_statistics_contract.multiple_testing: Holm; MOVE 两 exit 各 alpha=0.025 各自对 eligible candidates; PROCESS 单一 family (2 endpoints x eligible candidates) alpha=0.025
evaluation_statistics_contract.h2_rule: 每正式 seed 对照同 seed V543 M0/P0: MOVE rmse_zero <=2.0% 相对 / sign_accuracy <=0.01 绝对 / dead_fraction <=0.01 绝对增加 / fixed_coverage.direction_at_3 <=2.0% 相对; PROCESS endpoint.auprc <=0.01 绝对 / recall_at_fpr_0p05 <=0.02 绝对 / q.mae_curve_median <=5.0% 相对 / ordering.pairwise_accuracy_full <=0.02 绝对 / endpoint.ece <=0.02 绝对增加; 任一 seed breach => scientific_failure, 不得用另一 Track 收益豁免
evaluation_statistics_contract.h3_rule: MOVE: (rmse_pass AND direction_non_inferior) OR (direction_pass AND rmse_non_inferior); PROCESS: (auprc_pass AND q_non_inferior AND recall_non_inferior AND calibration_non_inferior AND ordering_non_inferior) OR (q_pass AND auprc_non_inferior AND recall_non_inferior AND calibration_non_inferior); >=2/3 seeds 同向 + 每 seed 无 H2 breach + 三 seed seed-averaged paired bootstrap 95% CI 下界 >0 + Holm 校正; 报告未校正与校正后结果
evaluation_statistics_contract.zero_baseline_rule: 相对阈值在对照基线为 0 或接近 0 时退化为绝对阈值: 退化 <=0.01 (比例类) 或 <=0.005 Å (距离类); WP0 写死, 不得事后选择更有利解释
evaluation_statistics_contract.q_validity: 报告 n_eval_curves / median_points_per_curve / frac_curves_ge3 / frac_curves_ge5; frac_curves_ge3 < 0.70 时 q.corr_curve_median 只作诊断
evaluation_statistics_contract.selection_rule: 每 Track 独立: 按预注册 screen score 排序取最多 2 名补 seed43; 最终冠军须三 seed H3 合格; 无合格候选则该 Track 保留 M0/P0 (正常负结果); tie-break = inner-val 主损失 -> core time -> 参数少 -> decoder_id 字典序

param_budget_signed.assertion: 构造时 sum(p.numel()) 精确断言; 估算值不得作为实现前 exact 断言; 禁止用 dead weights / 无用 bias 凑参数

training_dose_signed.dose_shape: 37,900 flat + 400 warmup (V542 的 400+37,500 两阶段在 Decoder-only 下无语义, 已废止)

run_matrix_signed.breakdown: T3 7 (seed 17) + T4 7 (seed 29) + T5 <=4 (seed 43, 每 Track 最多 2 名决赛者) = 18

parity_gate.note: 三 seed x >=8 真实 inner-val batch, CPU bitwise / GPU <=1e-6; 失败阻断所有训练并按缺陷类别 bump identity 层重跑; 不得用近似相等放行
